title: Talk ESD file format
summary: Talk scripts are state machines in .esd files. The file starts with fSSL. It holds state groups, states, conditions and a small expression bytecode.
values: magic fSSL, data start 0x6C, 32-bit varints; 194 ESDs in 10 talkesdbnd binders (m00, m10, m11_00, m11_01, m11_02, m13, m15, m17, m20, m25)
how: Own parser written for this atlas.

title: ESD expression bytecode
summary: Conditions are small programs. Bytes 0 to 0x7F are small ints, 0x80 float, 0x82 int32, 0xA5 text. 0x84 to 0x8A are function calls with 0 to 6 args. 0x8C to 0x9A are operators. 0xA1 ends.
check: Decode a known condition and compare with the SDT names.
note: Some functions have no name in the SDT file: f113, f114, f116, f124, f126.

title: ESD naming
summary: File name is t plus block (3 digits), group (2) and variant (1). Groups 00 to 06 per block are the idol menu.
values: t110100 = block 110, group 10, variant 0 ... ; talk binder m11_00_00_00.talkesdbnd

title: ESD command banks
summary: Commands are grouped by bank. Bank 1 is talk commands, 5 is misc, 6 calls another machine, 7 returns.
check: Dump a state and see the banks.

title: Most used ESD commands
summary: Counts over all 194 ESDs show what talk scripts do most.
values: RETURN 4885; SetEventFlag 1634; GiveSpEffectToPlayer 627; TalkToPlayer 528; AddTalkListData 502; OpenGenericDialog 173; OpenConversationChoicesMenu 108 (36 files); OpenRegularShop 87; OfferHumanity 91; AwardItemLot 50; OpenSellShop 16; OpenScalesShop 2; OpenTranspositionShop 2; UpgradeProstheticsMenu 2
check: Re-count with grep over dumped text.

title: TalkParam row
summary: One row is one spoken line. It points to the text id and up to 8 voice ids with animations and look targets.
values: 7380 rows; textId; soundId0..7 (+_female, soundId_pc); talkAnimation0..7 and _pc (100 default); lookAtTarget0..7 and _pc; lipSyncStart/Time; timeout
check: Read a row and match its text.

title: TalkParam id groups
summary: The first two digits of an 8-digit id name the speaker group. 7-digit ids are older or special.
values: 7026 eight-digit and 354 seven-digit ids; 10 Sculptor, 11 Wolf talk, 12 Hirata/Owl pre-fight, 13 idol, 16 Suzu-baba, 19 Anayama's servant, 24 Genichiro area, 26 Kotaro/Anayama talk, 34-36 shops (36 scales), 41-46 Memorial Mobs, 60 guards and moon-viewing, 65 ambient, 70 groaning victims
check: Read the first line of each group.
note: Groups 17 and 47 are not identified. Group names are partly inferred from text.

title: Dialogue text file
summary: Lines are in 会話.fmg with 6700 entries. Menu choices and talk list text sit in the event text file.
values: msg/engus/menu.msgbnd.d/会話.fmg; イベントテキスト.fmg (1032 ids): talk menu 15xxxxxx, choices 14xxxxxx; ダイアログ.fmg (161)

title: Voice lines
summary: A line plays an FMOD event named v0 plus the sound id. Events live in per-map voice banks.
check: Play the Owl line and check the bank.
note: Ours does not play voice length or lip sync.

title: Talk menu entries
summary: A talk offers a menu. Each entry is added by AddTalkListData with a text id and a result code. The menu closes on pick or cancel.

title: Choice menus
summary: A choice menu uses OpenConversationChoicesMenu. Text for options is in the 14xxxxxx range.
check: Talk to Kuro and watch the options.

title: TalkToPlayer line
summary: TalkToPlayer plays one TalkParam row and waits for it to end or a timeout.
values: 528 uses; args are the row and state machine ids

title: Generic dialog boxes
summary: OpenGenericDialog opens a small message box, such as a yes or no.
values: 173 uses; text from ダイアログ.fmg
check: Find one in an idol menu.

title: Opening shops from talk
summary: The ESD opens shops with a lineup id range. Several shop types exist.

title: Flags set by talk
summary: Talk scripts set event flags heavily to record story steps. 1634 SetEventFlag uses exist.

title: Lines gated by progress
summary: Conditions test flags and items to pick the line. One NPC may use 100 or more TalkParam rows for story stages.

title: Idol menu ESD
summary: Idols open a menu from a shared ESD family. Groups 00 to 06 per block call TalkParam 13030000.
values: 26414-byte ESDs t*00 to t*06; t000001 in m00 has 38 machines

title: Memories and Remnants
summary: The idol ESD checks item ranges for Memory and Remnant goods and offers their use.
check: Hold a Memory and open an idol.

title: Ambient overheard talks
summary: Guards talk when the player comes near. The script calls a machine with trigger distance, cancel distance, a done flag and a TalkParam row. It gives the player SpEffect 30700.

title: Eavesdrop player states
summary: The player has special states when listening in. They are crouch, stand, cover, cover-look and hang variants.
values: STATE_TYPE_EVENT_EAVESDROP_LOOP 98, _END 99; HKB 19210-19212 crouch, 19213-19215 stand, 19220-19222 cover, 19223-19225 cover-look, 19230-19232 hang
how: Player HKS and exe action name.
check: Find an eavesdrop point and enter it.
note: sekiro-rs lists eavesdrop as a gap. Which ESDs use the state is open-question.

title: Eavesdrop ESDs
summary: Some ESD text uses the word dummy for eavesdrop. t112500 holds a placeholder for a scene about the Imperial Prince. The wiki list was not available.
check: Find the spot in the Castle.
note: The Fandom page could not be fetched, so the wiki list is missing.

title: Owl pre-fight talk
summary: Our rebuild plays the Owl talk from t100121 with a flag check.
values: state group 2147483619; flag 71000137; TalkParam 12030000-12030005; flag 71000130; FMOD event v0<id> in vm10
note: No subtitles, lip sync or voice length in ours.

title: Hostile NPC talks
summary: Talk ESDs for bosses and enemies exist too. Rows such as 33160000 and 24060000 are fight chat.
values: t111330, t111331, t112330, t112331 (Genichiro); t100340, t100341 (Lady Butterfly area)

title: Dying soldiers
summary: Many 70xxxxxx rows are groans and short lines of wounded.

title: Line timing
summary: Each row holds a timeout and a lip sync start and length.

title: Engine talk classes
summary: The exe has talk classes for characters and the world.
values: SprjChrTalkModule, SprjWorldTalkMan, Npc Talk Ins, EzState Talk Env/Event, talkscript:/%s.talkesdbnd, data1:/script/talk, TalkMsg

title: Movie subtitles
summary: Subtitles for movies are a separate text file with 71 ids.

title: Dialogue coverage
summary: Our rebuild has the Owl pre-fight talk and item dialogs. sekiro-rs has none.
